rule: 596 resolved accounts = 562 original verified + 34 reserves substituted for failed originals; 4 slots unresolved; no further replacement round; 600 was a maximum.
evidence_note: official = profile externalUrl domain equals the clinic website domain (website link) and/or the clinic Google listing carries the Instagram link (listing contact data, with placeId, listing website and listing_instagram_link per account). Username/profile-name/biography-city are weak signals and never official. Every cohort account has at least one official basis.

unresolved_slots.reason: restricted profile, unresolved (conservative) (error Restricted profile; not counted as zero posts, not a clinic with no activity)

exclusions: Roster-level exclusions (1,146 non-clinics, closures, duplicates, etc.) are in exclusions.json; 647 listings with no Instagram link and 49 with an unverified link are kept apart (roster_unresolved.json, roster_unverified.json) and are not in the cohort.
